arguments.command:
cd . && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""          extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.35.1
""","""          extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.35.1
          # Only pit's `typescript` for the model. Not exclude_tools: pit's programs still call these through tools.*.
          model_tools_hidden: read, write, edit, bash
""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff; npx actionlint .github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml 2>&1 | tail -5; git checkout -b pi/issue-57-hide-default-tools && git commit -qam "ci: offer the model only pit's typescript tool in pi-assistant

Closes #57." && git push -q origin HEAD 2>&1 | tail -3
